Lena (Marketing): Heads-up: saw a spike in fastpath claim latency this morning — ~30% of inbound leads hit >10s between HS webhook and owner assignment. Notably tied to enrichment calls. Anyone else seeing this?
Diego (RevOps): Yep saw the same alerts. Enrichment svc p95 jumped. I pushed a temporary rule to route to overflow when enrichment >5s.
Priya (Sales Ops): Can we instead split the handling: if enrichment delayed, assign to fd-queue but tag for later enrichment? Don't want AEs losing leads or context.
Eli (Growth Ops): Agree. Minimum: metric + dashboard — %fastpath_claims >10s, median enrichment latency, number rerouted. Also add a tag so AEs know when enrichment is pending.
Nora (AE): From the trenches: leads routed without enrichment are acceptable if email + company present. Please add a short note to the lead about missing enrichment so AEs know it's incomplete.
Diego (RevOps): Plan: emit metric fastpath_claim_latency and property enrich_pending. Heartbeat from enrichment every 30s; if heartbeat missing or latency >5s -> fallback routing. I'll implement routing rule and alerts.
Lena (Marketing): Can someone draft the HubSpot workflow? Minimal fields: WHEN lead created AND enrich_pending=true -> assign to Overflow SDR; add task 'enrich-later' and a property note.
Priya (Sales Ops): HubSpot pseudocode:
```
WHEN lead.created
IF property.enrich_latency > 5000
THEN set owner = 'Overflow SDR'
AND create task = 'ENRICH LATER'
AND set property.enrich_pending = true
```
Eli (Growth Ops): Also propose a canary: 10% of fastpath traffic to alternate enrichment provider to measure p95 differences before switching.
Diego (RevOps): I'll add a Grafana panel: p95(fastpath_claim_latency) and alert: p95 > 8s for 5m. Also log the enrich provider id so we can compare in dashboards.
Nora (AE): :thumbsup: Please add a one-line AE handoff script: "Lead assigned before enrichment — we'll enrich and update contact within 24h." Put that in the playbook.
Lena (Marketing): I'll draft the playbook + internal note and customer-facing fallback language. ETA EOD today.
Routing Bot: routing-rule-applier: overflow_fallback=true applied for enrichment_latency>5000ms — rule_id=fr-2026-09-21-01
Priya (Sales Ops): Can we add a sample webhook replay and owner update snippet for on-call? e.g.:
```
POST /hubspot/webhook
{ "lead_id":"L-123", "enrichment_ms": 7234 }
PATCH /hubspot/contacts/L-123 { "owner":"Overflow SDR","properties":{"enrich_pending":"true"}}
```
Lena (Marketing): Great work. Let's reconvene at tomorrow standup to confirm the metrics trend and whether the canary needs scaling.
